# JS codegen for map<K,V> for-loop: emits for (const [k, v] of m.entries()) { ... }

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Handler contains a Map.entries() for-of loop.
grep 'for .* of .*\.entries' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    var total = 0
    button(text="sum", @click {
        for k, v = scores {
            total = total + v
        }
    })
    text(value=string(total))
}
